propositions: Duplicate policy frozensets and explicit intercept selection ladders must be removed; router must derive all policy sets exclusively from _registry.derive_policy_sets().
Every command intercept route must carry exactly one registered runtime-used argparse factory, one argv adapter, and one init policy, dispatching through a single _execute.execute path.
Generator commands gen_cli_help.py and gen_cli_reference.py must produce byte-identical output on successive renders and pass --check validation.

Whole-route and whole-parser shadow comparison must report no deltas in identity, mount/init, argv, diagnostics, output, streams, exit codes, aliases, or capability posture except approved help/overview normalization.
All behavioral contracts, subprocess E2E tests per intercept family, and production-path execution must pass after compatibility exports are removed and retired policy symbols are deleted.
